name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
description: XIAO ESP32-S3 with the Sense expansion board: a 2 MP camera (OV2640; newer batches ship the 3 MP OV3660) on the board-to-board connector, a digital PDM microphone and a microSD slot, plus everything the XIAO ESP32-S3 has (Wi-Fi / BLE not emulated, 8 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, 11 GPIOs D0 to D10, USB-C, built-in Li-ion charger with BAT pads). About 21 × 17.8 × 15 mm with the camera. The camera is wired inside: in code use esp_camera.h with the Sense's pins (XCLK 10, SIOD 40, SIOC 39, Y9..Y2 = 48, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 17, 15, VSYNC 38, HREF 47, PCLK 13; no PWDN / RESET). Mic: PDM CLK GPIO42, DATA GPIO41. microSD: CS GPIO21 (shared with the user LED) on the SPI pins D8 / D9 / D10. In Jumper's simulator the camera sees a test scene, an image, or your webcam (frames come from Jumper: QEMU does not model the camera interface). 3.3 V logic only.

availability.reason: Its fixture test passed on 2026-11-12 on the native QEMU jb7 (packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts, board seeed-xiao-esp32s3-sense: boot, GPIO out, GPIO in with the pull-up, Serial). The camera fixture (fixtures/esp32/esp_camera, the Sense's camera pins) captures JPEG, RGB565 and grayscale frames from Jumper through the esp32-camera API (camera.integration.test.ts). The jumper/qemu-esp Docker image with the camera port is not built.

pins.label: D0/A0
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO1; McuBackend pin "GPIO1" (pinMode(1, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D0 / A0 (ADC1, touch T1).

pins.label: D1/A1
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO2; McuBackend pin "GPIO2" (pinMode(2, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D1 / A1 (ADC1, touch T2).

pins.label: D2/A2
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO3; McuBackend pin "GPIO3" (pinMode(3, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D2 / A2 (ADC1). Strapping pin (JTAG source when the eFuse selects it; harmless otherwise).

pins.label: D3/A3
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO4; McuBackend pin "GPIO4" (pinMode(4, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D3 / A3 (ADC1).

pins.label: D4/SDA
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO5; McuBackend pin "GPIO5" (pinMode(5, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D4 / SDA: Wire SDA.

pins.label: D5/SCL
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO6; McuBackend pin "GPIO6" (pinMode(6, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D5 / SCL: Wire SCL.

pins.label: D6/TX
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO43; McuBackend pin "GPIO43" (pinMode(43, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D6 / TX: UART0 TX (Serial1 on the real board; in Jumper's simulator build Serial goes here too).

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: VBUS: 5 V from the USB-C port when plugged in (jumper.json power.usb, default plugged). Without USB it is an input (4.5 to 5.5 V); on battery this pad stays at 0 V (the charger never back-feeds it).

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground (all GND pins are one node).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board LDO (about 0.25 V dropout). Keep loads modest (Jumper checks 500 mA). The ESP32-S3 runs down to about 3.0 V.

pins.label: D10/MOSI
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO9; McuBackend pin "GPIO9" (pinMode(9, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D10 / MOSI: SPI MOSI. On the Sense this SPI pin also goes to the microSD slot.

pins.label: D9/MISO
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO8; McuBackend pin "GPIO8" (pinMode(8, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D9 / MISO: SPI MISO. On the Sense this SPI pin also goes to the microSD slot.

pins.label: D8/SCK
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO7; McuBackend pin "GPIO7" (pinMode(7, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D8 / SCK: SPI SCK. On the Sense this SPI pin also goes to the microSD slot.

pins.label: D7/RX
pins.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO44; McuBackend pin "GPIO44" (pinMode(44, …) in arduino-esp32). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Silkscreen D7 / RX: UART0 RX.

pins.label: BAT+
pins.description: Battery pad on the underside (+, the pad farther from USB): a 1S LiPo / Li-ion cell (3.7 V). The board's SGM40567 charger charges it from USB at 50 mA (3.8 mA trickle below 2.9 V, CV at 4.2 V); without USB the cell powers the board through its power path.

pins.label: BAT−
pins.description: Battery − pad on the underside (the pad nearer USB). Same node as GND.

props.label: Camera sees
props.description: What the camera sees in the simulator: a test scene, or 'image' (the still in camera_image: a scenario's camera_frame step, set_camera_frame, an image dropped on the part, or the webcam).

props.label: Camera image
props.description: A PNG or JPEG as a data URL (or base64), shown to the camera when 'Camera sees' is 'image'. Set at run time by tests, the agent or the browser; usually left empty in the project.

props.label: Microphone hears
props.description: What the on-board PDM microphone hears: quiet, a sine tone, noise, or the clip in mic_clip_b64 (16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM). Reaches the firmware only when the emulator's I2S receive works (docs/esp32-peripherals.md).

props.label: Microphone clip (16-bit PCM, base64)
props.description: Mono 16-bit little-endian PCM at 16 kHz, base64, played in a loop when 'Microphone hears' is 'clip'.

footprint: 21 × 17.8 mm castellated module, 2 × 7 pins at 0.1 in, BAT pads underneath; the Sense board and camera add height (about 15 mm in all)

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply wired to its power pins keeps the 3.3 V rail up; the firmware is held in reset while false.

strapping.note: GPIO3 (D2) selects the JTAG source only when the eFuse asks for it; on a stock XIAO anything may pull it.

toolchain.simNote: The simulator build sends Serial to UART0 (USB CDC On Boot: Disabled) and uses DIO flash, because the emulator has no USB serial and no QIO flash. The 8 MB octal PSRAM is emulated (QEMU's SPI PSRAM model, psramFound() is true). The camera's esp32-camera calls are answered by Jumper (frames from a scene, an image or the webcam). The factory pack builds the board's own settings: Serial on the USB-C port, OPI PSRAM, the real camera driver.

mcu.verified: packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts (boot, GPIO, Serial with the PSRAM=opi simulator FQBN); camera: packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/camera.integration.test.ts

camera.note: Seeed's camera_pins.h (CAMERA_MODEL_XIAO_ESP32S3). PWDN and RESET are not connected (-1).

features.description: camera lens (OV2640 / OV3660 module on the Sense board); the case opens a hole wide enough for its field of view
microSD slot on the Sense board; the card goes in before the case is closed (set expose true for a card slot)
PDM microphone sound port on the Sense board; set expose true for sound holes when the firmware listens
orange user LED (GPIO21, shared with the microSD CS); set expose true for a light pipe, e.g. to show when the camera is on
red charge LED (lit while the battery charges)
U.FL connector for the external antenna (keep metal away)

mechanical.source: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 Sense wiki (21 x 17.8 x 15 mm with the expansion board and camera). Part frame seen from the camera side: the XIAO's own components (USB-C, buttons, LEDs, U.FL) face -z, the lens +z. Lens, mic and microSD positions are approximate: measure your board before printing a tight case.
